summary_md: **AgentWire News ([@agentwirenews](https://x.com/agentwirenews/status/2115933283368260026))** reports **OpenCode 2.2.1** added `/goal`, letting a session keep working on an objective until a reviewer confirms it's met (with pause/resume/clear), and 2.2.2 enabled image generation by default for supported providers ([releases](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases)).
relevance: Goal-driven loops arriving in an open harness.
